cases.name: Counter payment into retained animation
cases.text: You may put three +1/+1 counters on target land you control. If you do, that land becomes a 0/0 Elemental creature with haste that's still a land.

cases.name: Counter payment with prior target
cases.text: Tap target creature. You may put two shield counters on target artifact. If you do, draw a card.

cases.name: Required counter payment
cases.text: Put two charge counters on target artifact. If you do, draw a card.

cases.name: Source receives counter payment
cases.text: You may put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. If you do, draw a card.

cases.name: Counter payment retains current animation
cases.text: You may put two +1/+1 counters on target artifact you control. If you do, that artifact becomes a 1/2 Wolf creature with vigilance that's still an artifact.

cases.name: Ordinary optional counters
cases.text: You may put two charge counters on target artifact.

cases.name: Another payer and another recipient
cases.text: Target player may put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. If they do, draw a card.

cases.name: Declining another payer counter cost
cases.text: Target player may put a shield counter on target artifact. If they don't, draw a card.
